name: Customer Identification
summary: Select an ID type, scan the document, validate with MOI and show the validated Identity Details in one card, in every journey.

name: Number Selection
summary: Choose a number: search, Free and Star bands, price filter, plan entitlement note, reserve and clear.

name: Billing Account
summary: Set up what an order bills to: one layout everywhere - the customer's existing billing accounts, or Create New Billing Account (contact, billing address, payment, card on file, primary payment profile, billing profile setup).

name: Service Address
summary: The address a service is activated at: one layout everywhere: Service Information (Kahramaa Meter ID / Vodafone Premise ID with Search), then Zone / Street / Building, then Additional Details, with Qatari-ID prefill.

name: Plan Selection
summary: Choose the plan: postpaid plan cards then Add-ons (discounts, bill limit), prepaid packs then Add-ons, or the fixed-line / fibre plan cards with the credit check. The line's current plan or pack can be left out of the choices when a journey changes it.

name: CAF & Signature
summary: The Customer Agreement Form: terms, CAF type, signature and supporting documents. Standard variant (name, key information, signature) and full variant (the customer reads back the Checkout Summary order, agrees the terms and signs; the journey locks once signed); postpaid and prepaid forms.

name: Checkout Summary
summary: The order read-back before signing and payment (plan, add-ons, discount, number, billing, monthly and one-off totals); publishes the totals and read-back rows the CAF and Payment reuse. An optional panel above it (the port-in validation gate). Includes the prepaid cart (Add another subscription) and the prepaid checkout, which a prepaid port-in also uses with its own lines, details and fees.

name: Payment
summary: Take the amount due at the counter through WinCash and record the outcome.

name: Appointment Booking
summary: Book the installation visit: SLA cluster, the date strip (next working days from the earliest, with each day's open slots), the day's time slots and technicians free, the customer's request for a specific date and time (a later date makes the order future-dated), appointment notes and the documents the technician collects (defaulted from the persona).

name: Activity Comments
summary: The closing note on the actions performed, with an optional channel.

name: Activation Complete
summary: The confirmation page for a submitted activation (facts, status, follow-on actions, eSIM handover, email) and the confirmed-order shape journeys hand it.

name: Selectable card styling
summary: One selected / idle / highlighted surface for plans, offers, numbers, add-ons, discounts and ID/customer type.

name: Side drawer
summary: Fixed 50%-width drawer for forms, details and multi-step flows: the title as a small uppercase label beside the close control, the body on the page tint, and a footer whose buttons share its width equally.

name: Toasts and notifications
summary: One-line toasts below the header; structured cards at the bottom.

name: Guided activation wizard
summary: The step shell every activation / migration / port-in journey runs in.

name: Eligibility gate
summary: Hard-stop / soft-stop / pass eligibility check shown after identification, with the outcome panel, checks report and footer actions.

name: Add-ons selection
summary: Add-on rows for a plan or prepaid pack, with included-benefit handling; on its own (Add Add-On) as a step that needs at least one add-on.

name: Customer Qualification
summary: Identify the customer, run eligibility, then offer the special-discount types - the whole "Customer Identification" step of an activation, with its outcomes and footer actions.

name: Line Selection
summary: Choose which of the identified customer's existing mobile lines an order changes (Change Postpaid Plan, Change Prepaid Pack, Add Add-On): postpaid and / or prepaid lines with their current plan and price; a line that is not active, is barred or whose billing profile is in collections is shown with its reason and cannot be chosen.

name: Customer Type & Discounts
summary: Special customer types (retired, MADA, B2B2C): the evidence the agent collects, the rules for accepting or rejecting the benefit, and the customer's benefits.

name: Cross-Sell Offers
summary: Recommended offers for the identified customer: offer cards, details drawer, interested (lead) and select actions, and hand-off to the other journeys.

name: SIM Type
summary: Choose and validate the SIM: Physical (scan or enter the serial) or eSIM (issued, handed over after payment).
